title: 仮設メッシュフェンス
description: 工事現場やイベント会場を囲う、置き式の仮設メッシュフェンス1枚です。亜鉛めっきの外枠パイプ、溶接金網、端部の連結クランプとボルト、パイプを差し込むコンクリート製の脚ブロックを造形しています。隣のパネル、目隠しシート、看板や文字、転倒防止の控えは含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.940 × 1.900 × 0.220 m、8,212三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: One freestanding temporary mesh fence panel for construction sites and events. It models the galvanized frame tubes, welded mesh, end couplers with bolts and concrete foot blocks that receive the uprights. Adjacent panels, privacy sheeting, signs or lettering and anti-tip stays are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.940 × 1.900 × 0.220 m; 8,212 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
